messages:
Marie (partnerships): Hey team — AcmeHW + CloudMarket joint webinar confirmed for May 14 10am PT. Need to lock speakers, demo fallbacks, and swag plan. Quick sync?
Daniel (events): Thanks — run-of-show draft in progress. Can we confirm who will do the 10min keynote vs 15min live demo?
Elaine - AcmeHW: I'll take the 10min keynote and introduce the hardware story. Acme can do a 12min live demo but we want a 5min pre-recorded backup in case remote demo fails.
Sophia (solutions): Sounds good. Raj, you okay to handle the Redwood live model pipeline demo? We can pre-record a short sequence too.
Raj (devrel): Yes. I'll prepare a 4-step demo: provisioning -> inference -> latency dashboard -> failover to quantized model. Will record a 5min backup.
Greg - CloudMarket: From marketplace side, we need a slide about deployment options and marketplace listing CTA. Also compliance blurb for enterprise customers.
Marie (partnerships): Action items: 1) Speakers confirmed (Elaine keynote, Raj live demo), 2) Pre-record backups from both Acme and Redwood, 3) Slide deck share by May 1.
Daniel (events): AV notes: we need HDMI passthrough test, remote desktop sharing permission, and a BYO dongle fallback. Event-bot: Reminder scheduled: "AV dry-run May 12 9am PT" (channel: #events). :calendar:
Lucas (swag-ops): For swag, we can do 300 mixed bundles (sticker pack + cable + Acme-branded microfiber). Need shipping addresses by May 6. Any customs-sensitive items?
Elaine - AcmeHW: Microfiber is fine. One ask: can Redwood include a short printed 2-sided quickstart (1 page) for the demo flow in the bundle? We can provide a PDF by May 3.
Lucas (swag-ops): Yep — send print-ready PDF. Also let me know which countries to ship to (we'll mark as electronics accessory).
Sophia (solutions): Security checklist: no PII in demo data, recorded demos must use synthetic data. Raj — confirm the model logging level is off for prod tokens.
Raj (devrel): Confirmed — we'll use anonymized prompts and regenerate examples. Also adding a note in the deck: "No customer data used."
Marie (partnerships): Marketing/registration: Greg, please share the co-branded landing URL and UTM tags; we need a CTA for Marketplace listing signup.
Greg - CloudMarket: Will share URL by Friday. Proposed UTM: ?utm_source=acme&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=may14_demo
Daniel (events): Run-of-show snippet (tentative): 10:00 intro (Marie, 3m) -> Keynote (Elaine, 10m) -> Demo (Raj, 12m) -> Marketplace CTA (Greg, 5m) -> Q&A (10m). Can we shave 2m off somewhere?
Elaine - AcmeHW: We can tighten keynote to 8m if needed.
Raj (devrel): I can compress demo to 10m if I remove deep dive on KV cache tuning; put that in a follow-up tech doc.
Marie (partnerships): Great — compressed plan looks good. Who will host the rehearsal on May 12? Daniel?
Daniel (events): I'll run the rehearsal. Please join 9am PT. I'll post calendar invite.
Sophia (solutions): Demo fallback plan: primary = live remote on Acme hardware (shared screen), fallback A = Redwood recorded backup clip + slides, fallback B = pre-provisioned VM instance with scripted run (hosted by CloudMarket). We should test Fallback B on May 12.
Greg - CloudMarket: I'll provision a VM snapshot and share SSH creds in a secure doc. We'll coordinate network egress tests.
Lucas (swag-ops): Shipping manifest request: send me attendee list + mailing addresses CSV by May 6. Also confirm one expedited sample bundle to Acme office for approval.
Elaine - AcmeHW: We'll approve sample. Ship to: AcmeHW Ops, 420 Fabrication Way, Austin TX 78701.
Marie (partnerships): Quick comms ask: can everyone tag deliverables in this thread as DONE when completed? Will compile final checklist.
Raj (devrel): Will post demo recording by May 3 (DONE when uploaded).
Elaine - AcmeHW: Pre-recorded keynote video uploading today to shared Drive (link in DM).
Greg - CloudMarket: Landing URL + UTM live: https://cloudmarket.example/partners/redwood-acme?utm_source=acme&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=may14_demo
Daniel (events): Calendar invites sent for rehearsal + dry-run. Event-bot: RSVP summary will post 48h before event. :white_check_mark:
Marie (partnerships): Perfect — I'll assemble the final runbook after May 6 (post-swagger manifest). Thanks team!
Lucas (swag-ops): Noted — sample out for review tomorrow.
Sophia (solutions): Adding a follow-up doc for deep-technical appendix to link in post-event email.
Raj (devrel): One last note — include a short troubleshooting slide with the exact curl snippet to repro the demo locally in case of remote issues:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","prompt":"hello"}'
```
Elaine - AcmeHW: Good call. I'll include a quick hardware status check checklist too.
Marie (partnerships): Awesome. Closing thread for now — will re-open if any blocker. :tada:
